name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

host.title: FreeCAD host
host.description: The address or hostname of the machine running FreeCAD (127.0.0.1 by default). localhost, ::1 and 127.x.x.x count as this machine. For another host, also set Bearer token and Certificate (PEM) below.

port.title: MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the port of the entry you connect to in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge → Listen addresses. Extension 0.1.27.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Required. Paste the token FreeCAD showed. The extension uses only this setting, on this machine and for another host, and writes nothing. A bearer token uses letters, digits and - . _ ~ + /, with = at the end.

tls_cert_file.title: Certificate (PEM)
tls_cert_file.description: Used for another host only, where it is required. Set this to a copy of FreeCAD's certificate file, not the private key, so the extension connects over HTTPS and trusts only that certificate. On this machine the extension reads serving-cert.pem in the bridge's folder, and uses HTTPS only when that file is present.
